name: New Dog 15
author: PriyanshuGupta28
description: Neon pill violet toggle switch that toggles on and off when clicked.
howItWorks: On hover, background-color changes from #ccc to #999, background-color changes from #ccc to #63218a. Clicking it toggles it: background-color changes from #ccc to #6000df, transform becomes translateX(26px), background-color changes from #ccc to #63218a. On focus, box-shadow becomes 0 0 0 3px #000000.
